primary_source.label: Primary Source
primary_source.trigger: The cited work is where the summarized argument originates (the book being synthesized, or the author's own chapter).

mechanism.label: The Mechanism
mechanism.trigger: Source supplies the theory or causal explanation beneath a claim (RFT, semantic satiation, ironic process theory).

evidence.label: The Evidence
evidence.trigger: Source is an empirical study, trial, or meta-analysis supporting a quantitative or research claim. Card must carry effect direction + durability caveat when known.

counterpoint.label: The Counterpoint
counterpoint.trigger: Source challenges, limits, or complicates the guide's thesis. MUST pair with the caution-styled card, never the standard note card.

parallel_track.label: Parallel Track
parallel_track.trigger: Adjacent tradition arriving at a similar conclusion by a different route (decentering, distanced self-talk, narrative therapy).

practitioner.label: For Practitioners
practitioner.trigger: Clinical manual or applied how-to (Learning ACT, ACT Made Simple, Mastery of Your Anxiety and Panic).
